question: Does the largest image-representation layer also provide the strongest scientific measurement state, or does task fitness diverge from byte footprint?
terminal_objective: Convert the verified source/raw/processed byte ledger and the Data User Guide's processing limits into a task-conditioned representation gate without opening pixels or judging archive quality.
method: Replay the Stage 10L complete-action cohort and Stage 10S plan-bounded Sunset block, compute representation byte shares, verify the guide's source/raw/processed semantics and no-calibrated-product boundary, and map five predeclared task intents to the narrowest admissible representation state.
authority: Private local metadata and document analysis only. No pixels, calibration, color or photometric measurement, representation-quality ranking, archive-waste claim, scientific-content-loss claim, model-performance claim, publication, novelty, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 10V may establish that processed TIFFs occupy 67.932% of bytes in the verified complete-action cohort and 68.447% in the fixed Sunset block while the Data User Guide defines all crew-camera products as uncalibrated and warns that processed colors cannot be completely verified or quantified. It may establish a task-conditioned representation gate: source preserves native pixels and metadata, raw exposes the Bayer array in an open archival format, processed provides a viewable vendor interpretation, and none is a calibrated physical-unit or quantitatively verified-color product. It cannot rank one representation universally, call any tier defective or wasteful, infer a specific pixel artifact, measure color or photometry, infer scientific-content loss, generalize byte shares beyond the frozen cohorts, or claim scientific discovery, novelty, or priority.

next_step_logic.if_visual_review_is_selected: Use processed or browse products as interpreted viewing carriers while keeping their uncalibrated status explicit.
next_step_logic.if_bayer_level_analysis_is_selected: Use raw products and preserve source products for provenance; freeze any autoscaling, demosaicing, and calibration assumptions separately.
next_step_logic.if_quantitative_color_or_photometry_is_s: Stop: no archived tier supplies instrument-independent calibrated values or fully verified color without an external calibration and validation design.
next_step_logic.if_download_budget_is_selected: Choose representation after the task, not by treating the largest byte tier as the strongest evidence tier.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A calibrated crew-camera collection, validated color response, revised processing documentation, or a real task whose representation requirements differ.
